name: watermill-managed-subscription-outcomes
instr:
Give Watermill subscribers an opt-in managed lifecycle that preserves the existing message stream while exposing why consumption ended. Carry that outcome through routing, flow, CQRS, and request/reply APIs without changing successful delivery, acknowledgement, retry, redelivery, or correlation behavior.
